The ideal candidate has strong backend expertise in Python, frontend experience with React and TypeScript, and hands-on knowledge of AWS cloud-native architectures.

This role requires technical ownership, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate with Product and Data teams in dynamic environments.

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

• Strong proficiency in Python, preferably FastAPI.

• Experience with React and TypeScript for frontend development.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar.

• Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable applications.

• Strong ownership, analytical thinking, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to work independently in ambiguous or fast-changing environments.
